inspection.question: Does real-provider validation expose a proven security gap requiring code changes before the test?
evidence: N7.6 certifies tenant/RBAC enforcement, fail-closed boundary behavior, scoped anonymous webhook, opaque sensitive references, validation, auditing/observability and non-exposure of secrets.
N8.6 must not synthesize access tokens, phone-number IDs, QR/session state or provider readiness.
The remaining risk is operational authorization to a real non-production provider account and recipient, not an internal security defect demonstrated by current evidence.
inspection.scopeDecision: Preserve N7.6 controls; require N8.6.G to perform real-provider validation with authorized external access and non-secret evidence.
